product.title: PRIVATE Eco Boat Trip out of Naples Bay, FL , island stop incl.

description.text: Florida's south-west coast is filled with sea life, wildlife, and nature sightseeing you won't want to miss. This Naples Bay and Gulf of Mexico Private Eco Tour by Boat takes you to areas along the water in Naples Bay and the Gulf of Mexico so you can see a variety of animals and fish in their natural habitat. Plus, a guide narrates so you can learn about the ecosystem, too.Explore Naples Bay and the Gulf of Mexico during a private boat tour Visit Ten Thousand Islands, Gordon Pass, and Keewaydin Island in one day See wildlife from dolphins and manatees to blue herons and deer A private group o Ideal for Naples and Marco Island visitors who want shallow-water shelling, dolphin watching, and mangrove-lined routes without chartering a boat alone.
